skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature and role of key IMC tools
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and role of key IMC tools and how to integrate them in a marketing communication campaign.
Manage integrated marketing communication activities within businesses, including internal and external factors affecting these activities.
Plan integrated marketing communication activities, including setting goals, budgets, and evaluating effectiveness.
Develop creative strategies and build messaging based on understanding target audiences and brand identity.
Analyze and select media channels for marketing communication campaigns.
Work collaboratively in teams to develop and evaluate integrated marketing communication plans suitable for business situations.
Make ethical decisions and demonstrate social responsibility in evaluating and recommending marketing communication decisions.
